jobDescription:
Senior Frontend Engineer — Web Platform

We're building a fast, accessible web application and need a senior frontend engineer to lead the UI.

Requirements:
- React for building component-driven UIs
- TypeScript across the frontend codebase
- Next.js for server-rendered and statically generated pages
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- GraphQL for data fetching from our API
- Redux or a comparable state-management library
- Jest and Playwright for unit and end-to-end testing
- Webpack or a modern bundler for production builds
- Node.js for backend-for-frontend services
- CI/CD for automated checks and deploys
